script_text: Neptune, your ruling planet, is about to trigger a seismic shift in your 7th House of partnerships this week, Pisces. Monday Venus in Gemini sextiles Neptune in Aries, opening romantic doors you never expected. Tuesday Mercury in Gemini squares Saturn in Aries, so double-check every email before hitting send — miscommunications could cost you a client. Wednesday the Sun in Gemini trines Jupiter in Gemini, firing up your 10th House career prospects, making it your power day. Thursday Mars in Taurus squares Neptune, creating tension with a close partner — avoid ultimatums. Friday Venus enters Cancer activating your 4th House, pulling you toward family healing and quiet reflection. Saturday Neptune stations direct, clearing emotional fog very quickly. Sunday the Moon conjuncts your natal Neptune brings deep intuitive guidance. Your worst day is Thursday, guard carefully. Don't sign contracts before Friday. Follow for daily updates today.
